SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-11: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — View Runner, Examples. Test these items: execute a ViewDefinition and return tabular rows, simple Patient and Observation example views, unrolling arrays such as Patient.address into row sets, filtered Observation/resource views, column type coercion into DuckDB result columns, official SQL-on-FHIR v2 spec_tests parity, parser, generator, and DuckDB execution agree for supported examples. When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath lowBoundary/highBoundary utility functions; SQL-on-FHIR v2 local spec_tests/fn_boundary.json
issues.evidence: Fresh SOF-VD-11/SKEPTIC probe executed generated ViewDefinition SQL over a shared resources table with native C++ and forced Python fallback. For official fn_boundary decimal lowBoundary/highBoundary, resource o1 has valueQuantity.value 1.0 and expected 0.95/1.05. Native C++ returned -0.5/0.5 because value.ofType(Quantity).value.precision() returned 0, while forced fallback returned precision 1 and 0.95/1.05.
issues.root_cause: Native C++ FHIRPath member access did not preserve raw JSON number text for numeric children, and decimal boundary calculation read decimal_val from JSON-backed numeric FPValues instead of the JSON numeric accessor. The same official runner sweep exposed related native primitive metadata gaps for FHIR date/dateTime/time boundary coercion and root-level where(criteria), which fell through as a generic function instead of using the existing filter implementation.
issues.resolution: Updated native evaluator member access to preserve JSON numeric source_text, updated decimalBoundary to use getNumericValue() for JSON-backed numbers, added FHIR primitive metadata coercion for JSON date/dateTime/time strings before lowBoundary()/highBoundary(), and dispatched top-level where(criteria) through evalWhere(). Rebuilt and copied the bundled DuckDB extension. Added native/fallback FHIRPath parity and ViewDefinition runner regression tests.
